review.notes:
Zebrasplit signs in with a phone number and a 6-digit code that we text you. This demo account has no password, so please use the code route below rather than the password screen.

To sign in:
1. On the welcome screen tap "Log in".
2. On the "Log in" screen, tap "Text me a code instead" at the BOTTOM of the screen. (The "Continue with email or phone" button goes to a password screen, which this account does not use.)
3. Enter the phone number 5555550101 and tap "Send code".
4. Enter the code 123456.

5555550101 is a reserved test number with a fixed code, so no real SMS is sent and the code never changes. The account is "Jordan Test", already a member of two trips with expenses, so every screen has data in it.

What to look at:
- Open the trip "Cabo crew: Casa Azul", then tap "Close out" to see the settlement and the payment buttons.
- Each payment shows which app it will open. Tapping the small logo chip under a payment lets you switch between the apps that person accepts.

Notes on specific features:
- Zebrasplit never holds, moves or processes money, and never asks for bank or card details. The Pay button opens Venmo, Cash App or PayPal with the amount pre-filled; the payment happens entirely inside that app. Payments can also just be marked as paid by hand.
- "Dazzle" is the in-app word for a trip (a group of zebras is called a dazzle). A "stripe" means a member has finished adding expenses.
- Receipt scanning: tap the camera on an expense to photograph a receipt. The photo is read to extract the line items and total. Any photo of a restaurant or store receipt works.
- Contacts access is only used to let the user pick who to invite, and only the numbers they select are ever sent.
- The account can be deleted in-app from Profile > Settings > Delete account.

en-US.title: Zebrasplit
en-US.subtitle: Split and share expenses
en-US.promoText: Everyone gets a zebra. Log what you paid, dress your zebra, and settle the whole trip with one payment each.
en-US.description:
Zebrasplit is the expense sharing app without the confusion and hassle of leading competitors.

Split the trip or expense, track who paid for what, know exactly when everyone is done, then settle the whole thing with a single payment each.

EVERYONE GETS A ZEBRA

Your group is a herd. Every person in the trip is their own zebra, standing in a field on the trip page. A zebra is plain until its owner has finished adding expenses, then it earns its stripes. One glance tells you who you are still waiting on, by name.

Nudge anyone holding things up. If someone never responds, the trip owner can close it out anyway.

DRESS YOUR ZEBRA

Hats, shades, chains, hoodies, jerseys, a crown if you've earned it. Pick one for the head, one for the face and neck, one for the body. Everyone in your trips sees what you're wearing, and some items you earn rather than buy: settle your first trip, settle five, send your first gift.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Start a trip and invite your people from your contacts or by phone number.
2. Everyone logs what they paid as they go.
3. Each person taps Done when they've finished adding expenses.
4. Once every zebra has its stripes, Zebrasplit works out the fewest payments that settle the group and opens Venmo, Cash App or PayPal with the amount already filled in.

SPLIT IT HOWEVER IT ACTUALLY HAPPENED

- Evenly, by exact amounts, by percentage or by shares
- By nights stayed, so people who arrive late pay less automatically
- Item by item from a photo of the receipt
- In any currency, with the exchange rate locked in when you save

ONE PAYMENT EACH, NOT FIVE

Instead of six people paying six people, Zebrasplit works out the smallest set of payments that settles everyone, so you usually pay one person once. Tap Pay and Venmo, Cash App or PayPal opens with the amount ready to send.

Zebrasplit never touches your money. It never holds funds, never processes a payment and never asks for bank or card details. Paying another way - cash, Zelle, a bank transfer - works fine too; just mark the payment as paid.

FRIENDS DON'T NEED THE APP

Anyone you invite gets a text with a link. They can open it in a browser, verify their number, add expenses and tap Done without installing anything.

AFTER THE TRIP

Settled trips move to Past with a recap: the total, cost per person, the biggest expense and who fronted the most. Export it as an image for the group chat.

FREE

Splitting, stripes and settling up are free, and always will be. Outfits are optional.
